rationale: Same pin, no upstream change. The only mapped file that changed is plugins/delivery-harness/skills/delivery/SKILL.md, whose frontmatter gains two keys after the description: model: inherit and effort: high. The skill body, references, scripts and tests are byte-identical, so the upstream-derived rules this record covers are unchanged. model: inherit keeps the bundle's rule that configured models are inherited and never pinned (README, PROVENANCE, SKILL.md 'Use configured/inherited models'); effort: high applies to a delivery turn on a host that reads the key and is ignored by hosts that do not. Delivery runs its own bundled copies and does not invoke the upstream skills, so their own frontmatter changes on separate branches do not reach this pin.
reviewer: Independent read-only reviewer agents that did not write the change, on October 24, 2026. The first reviewed the uncommitted diffs of all eleven repositories in this change: the delivery SKILL.md is byte-identical apart from the two added lines, its frontmatter parses as YAML with valid values, validate_bundle passes, and delivery does not load the upstream skills. A second, error-path reviewer checked these records against review_data (source revision equals the pinned submodule, disposition valid, non-empty fields, upstream paths present at the pin, unique integration paths, lock hashes equal to the files, lock byte-identical to the tool's output) and flagged that an earlier model: opus contradicted the inherited-models rule; model: inherit resolves it. Review prose does not authenticate identity.
